title: Terminal and Echo Anew
author: Lior Ishikawa
blurb: Hazel Okafor, a pilot bonded to an AI that lies, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. But when the colony's children start sharing the same dream, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must deliver a message that will end the war — or start it, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
